rounds.title: Stream baseline
rounds.note: The SDK stream player slot (etStreamPlayerSlot) and the overlays it mounts in flow, first drawing, drawn by the mock from @ethlete/components/design/stream with the real markup and CSS: the player slot, the shared overlay card, et-stream-consent, et-stream-player-loading (et-spinner, 35px, stroke 2, with track, the sweep held at one frame), et-stream-player-error and et-pip-slot-placeholder, plus the button and icon sheets; default labels and button colors (null, so the buttons take the color theme around them, brand mint here). No real third-party player or iframe: the player element is a neutral fake video box (14 % surface ink on the surface, a muted play glyph). The slot is framed as a page with 16px padding, full width, 16:9 (the consumer sets the size; the slot itself only clips to a 12px radius). Widths 320 (288 x 162 slot: under the 200px container height the overlay card hides its icon), 480 (448 x 252) and 720 (688 x 387). States: player (the bare player), consent (the lock, Content blocked, the description, filled Allow and play; no player behind it, the slot holds it back until consent), loading (the spinner on the surface, over the player), error (the triangle, Playback failed, the description, filled Retry), pip-placeholder (the arrow-out icon, Playing in picture-in-picture, filled Back to player: the box left behind when the player floats), consent-hover, consent-active and consent-focus-visible (the accept button forced). Numbers (light / dark), from shot pixels at scale 2 at 480, brand mint, a: heading (consent, error) vs the overlay 17.93 / 17.18; description and PiP message (muted) 7.81 / 6.94; card icon (subtle) 4.95 / 4.99; the overlay fill is the page surface (1.00 / 1.00); spinner arc (primary) vs overlay 1.33 / 13.50, vs its 24 % track 1.19 / 7.29; filled button vs overlay 1.33 / 13.50, its label 15.82 / 15.82; button focus ring (the focused fill colour) vs overlay 1.37 / 13.06; hover fill vs rest 1.03 / 1.03; fake video vs page 1.33 / 1.51 (light / dark, fixture only). Q98 numbers only: the slot has no edge, and every overlay paints the page surface, so in consent, loading, error and PiP the slot's box and 12px radius vanish into the page (1.00 / 1.00). Decided rules that arise: Q88 (the button focus ring), Q99a (the spinner arc, a primary-coloured mark; the filled button is a mint fill, so it takes a 1px inset ink edge) and Q101 (filled button hover = -active). The ink edge on the mint fill arises, so Q102 arises: b draws the edge in both schemes, c keeps dark as today (edge light-dark(ink, transparent)). Findings for later: (1) every overlay paints --et-surface-background-solid, the same as the page, so the player area loses its shape behind consent, loading, error and PiP; a later round could give the overlays a raised or tinted surface or an edge (open call, not drawn). (2) At the slot's rounded corners the fake video shows a faint anti-aliased halo through the loading overlay (both clipped by the same 12px radius); with a real dark video it would read as a thin grey corner ghost. (3) et-button sets no font-family, so the labels render in the UA button font, not the page font (all three overlay buttons). (4) The overlay card (container-type: size) raises a ResizeObserver loop warning in the render check; harmless here. (5) The spinner's arc halves clip on purpose: marked data-et-skip CLIPPED on the et-spinner in every variant, not a bug. Later rounds, left out here: the floating PiP window and its chrome (pip-chrome, the PiP overlay card, the dark PiP surface, the bring-back pulse), the consent provider flow, custom labels and button colors, a custom spinner size, a real player and iframe, RTL, long labels, the error and PiP buttons forced into hover and focus (they are the same et-button as consent).

a.note: Today, the lib as is. On light the mint marks sit near 1.33: the spinner arc vs overlay 1.33 (1.19 vs its track), the filled button vs overlay 1.33, its focus ring (the focused fill) 1.37; dark 13.50 / 13.50 / 13.06. Hover moves the fill by 1.03. Text as in the round note: heading 17.93 / 17.18, description 7.81 / 6.94, icon 4.95 / 4.99.

b.note: Pick. a plus Q88, Q99a and Q101, decided rules only. Q99a: the spinner arc takes light-dark(ink, primary): light 5.48 vs overlay (was 1.33), 3.88 vs its track (was 1.19); dark unchanged (13.50, 7.29 vs track). The filled button keeps the mint with a 1px inset ink edge: light edge 5.48 vs overlay, 4.13 vs the fill (2.45 vs the hover fill); dark the ink is the mint, so the edge merges with the rest fill (1.00) and shows 1.69 on the hover fill. Q88: the button focus ring in ink, light 7.68 vs overlay (the focused ink, was 1.37), 5.60 vs the focused fill; dark 13.50 vs overlay. Q101: hover = -active, 1.69 from rest (was 1.03), label 9.38 (was 15.30); hover fill vs overlay 2.24 / 8.01. Applies to all three overlay buttons (Allow and play, Retry, Back to player). Text unchanged. Picked because these are the only decided rules that apply, they lift every light mark past 3:1, and ink following the scheme matches the loader, query-error and banner b picks. Q102 open; if dark should stay as today, take c.

c.note: b with the button's inset edge in light-dark(ink, transparent) (Q102): light equals b (edge 5.48 vs overlay, 4.13 vs fill; spinner 5.48; ring 7.68; hover 1.69 from rest). Dark: no edge on the fill, as today; the ring stays ink (13.50 vs overlay, Q88), hover takes -active (Q101), the spinner arc is the primary as in a. It keys on color-scheme, not on the surface; my reading of rule a, not a decided rule (Q102).
